correctness.rationale: The parametrized Fermat line intersections give a connected branch graph with V=3ell^2+6ell+3ell^3 and E=6ell^2+6ell^3. Frobenius q-multiplication has one fixed hexagon and six fixed leaves when its order d>1; all other edge/vertex orbits have length d for prime ell. Rooted quotient lifting yields an invariant spanning tree and thereby the exact integral Z plus R/d regular summands, not just rational character. Normalization and p>ell local log give the split unipotent dimension; Lang and finite abelian Sylow decomposition give rational point groups. Adjunction independently reproduces genus; two exact programs verify geometry and tree construction.

value.rationale: A complete integral arithmetic torus classification is a natural discrete arithmetic invariant of the standard Fermat line divisor. It is strictly richer than its already known geometric genus and zeta function and yields the exact rational-point group for all prime degrees and all Frobenius orders, notably three distinct algebraic tori in degree five. The invariant-tree method gives a reusable structural lemma rather than a routine numeric variant.
